title: sdks: unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics and parity, bump v1.162.0
author: Ava Chen
description:
Motivation: Bring parity and improved ergonomics to all official SDKs (Python / TypeScript / Go) for auth handling, retry semantics, and streaming APIs. This PR consolidates client-side auth+retry behavior to a shared spec, fixes streaming edge-cases (cancelation and reconnect), and bumps package versions to v1.162.0. Changes are intentionally small per-repo but coordinated across SDKs to avoid behavioral drift.

What changed: unified retry policy (exponential backoff with full jitter, configurable max attempts and per-request override), standardized token refresh flow (single refresh in-flight per client), streaming helpers to simplify reconnect/cancel logic and ensure consistent chunk framing across languages, and minor ergonomics tweaks (named params, clearer error types, improved docs/comments). Includes unit + integration test coverage and migration notes.

Testing: added cross-language integration tests that run against the local contract server; CI runs native test matrices for each runtime. See commits for details.

Checklist: [x] Spec doc updated (ENG-2245) [x] Tests added/updated [x] Changelog + migration notes included [x] Coordinated release tag bump to v1.162.0
commits: python: unify auth retry implementation, add backoff+jitter, tests
typescript: normalize streaming edge cases, add reconnect helper, update docs
go: single-flight token refresh, retry middleware, tests
spec: update SDK auth/retry/streaming contract and examples
chore: bump sdk versions to v1.162.0 across repositories
changed_snippets: typescript/streaming.ts: add reconnect() helper and cancel() semantics
go/auth.go: use singleflight to dedupe refresh calls
review_comments: Ravi Patel: Please add an integration test that simulates token expiry during an in-flight streaming session.
Ava Chen: Added integration test (contract_server) and updated CI matrix to include the token-expiry scenario.
Elena Gomez: lgtm for Python/TS; left one comment on Go error wrapping to preserve original error for telemetry.
Samir Kaur: CI flake on typescript lint in first run, re-ran and fixed formatting; approving after green CI.
release_notes: SDKs: unified auth/retry behavior across Python/TypeScript/Go, improved streaming ergonomics (reconnect/cancel), single-flight token refresh to avoid thundering refreshes, and package version bumps to v1.162.0. Migration: if you override retry behavior directly, please move to the new RetryConfig API; streaming reconnect helper is opt-in.
notes_for_release_team: Coordinate publishing order: python -> typescript -> go to avoid brief mismatches in behavior for multi-lang clients. Tagged all repos with v1.162.0. Notify integrators about RetryConfig API rename.
risk_and_mitigation: Low: changes are localized to SDK client-side behavior. Mitigations: backward-compatible defaults, migration notes, increased test coverage and staggered rollout.
